title: 20-second UFO sighting the same day
summary: Brandon Fugal tells of 20-second UFO sighting the same day, about October, 2016-2026 at Skinwalker Ranch, Utah, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: a dramatic UFO sighting right in front of us.

plain: Brandon Fugal, the owner of Skinwalker Ranch, a Utah property known for reports of strange events, tells a podcast host, Jesse Michels, that one October day he and others had a dramatic UFO sighting right in front of them. He says it lasted about 20 seconds and happened on the same day as other events at the ranch. He tells it as proof that something unusual really goes on there.
